<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

With legacy database semantic conventions removed, use the shared SQL getter and extractor for Couchbase 2.x SQL++ queries. Keep key-value operations and opaque view queries on the generic instrumenter.

Setting `otel.instrumentation.couchbase.query-sanitization.enabled=false` now disables masking only for `db.query.text`. Query summaries and query-derived span names are still produced, matching other SQL instrumentations. The same behavior applies when sanitization is disabled through the common database setting.

Couchbase SQL spans no longer emit `db.operation.name`. Existing configuration names and precedence are unchanged; the telemetry changes are documented in the changelog.

Keep Geode's direct `SqlQueryAnalyzer` use for OQL literal masking, since SQL summaries do not model its region paths. Retain the expanded sanitization test.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Fixes #19230
metadata.title: Adopt SQL getters for Couchbase 2.x queries
